svg.title: Instances: Captured and Restored as One Group
svg.desc: The agent on rank 0's node leads. Once the instance is Ready it checks the instance and has every node's agent dump its own member at a shared freeze point, then writes a group record naming each member's checkpoint. A later instance of the same configuration and size is admitted as placeholders, one per slot; the leader restores every member with one address map and connections locked: the GPU ranks first, each reloading its GPU memory, then the companions; then it unlocks them all.
svg.text: Instances: Captured and Restored as One Group
Two GPU nodes and the companions of one tensor-parallel instance. The same paths carry the capture and the restore.
Leader: the agent on rank 0's node
checks the instance, drives the freeze point and writes the group record;
at restore, restores the GPU ranks with their GPU memory, then the companions, then unlocks them all
dumps or restores its own node's member

etcd, NATS, a frontend; no GPUs
a new member becomes the placeholder
The leader refuses the capture unless the instance is opted in (when it has more than one pod), every rank runs under gpushare, its ranks form a whole engine, no member's liveness probe would
restart it during the freeze, every node's agent runs the same revision, and every member passes the preflight.
Each node's agent dumps its own member. Every member waits at the freeze point and the leader releases them together, or aborts them all (next figure). 3 The group record names every member's
Each new member of an instance of the same configuration and size becomes a placeholder of its slot (nvsnap.io/criu-group, its ordinal and the group size). A member that cannot restore with
its instance starts cold; the other placeholders then cannot restore together and are deleted once the restore stalls. A member whose new address collides with an old one is replaced.
